title: Domestic Girlfriend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Natsuo has a crush on his teacher Hina and sleeps with a girl named Rui after a mixer. When his father remarries, both women become his stepsisters, and the story follows his secret relationship with Hina and later his romance with Rui as they grow into adulthood.
life_message: A good life follows the heart through messy relationships toward honest love and a chosen career.
